name: prog
description: Keeps the full output of test, build, and lint runs, adds a short receipt after each, and never lets 'fixed' be claimed without proof

stop_gate.title: Stop gate
stop_gate.description: Before Claude finishes a turn, block once if this session's newest test run is failing, does not prove an earlier failure fixed, or is older than the files it tested, or if the newest lint or build run is failing. Never blocks on missing evidence, and stands aside when Claude already said the tests are open
